messages.text: I’m such a dunce…..I know I’ve ordered multiple miners, PSU’s and accessories from helium deploy - but I can’t track down all the emails for confirmation.  Is there a way to sign in and check all items that I’ve ordered, somehow?
Used the store-orders skill

Not a dunce at all. You don't need to sign in, I can pull it all up here. There are two orders on (email hidden):

Shop···· (July 25) is fully delivered. The Bitaxe Supra Hex arrived September 10 and the NerdOctaxe arrived September 15.

Shop···· (August 1) is your B30 with the free Power Kit. Both are paid and haven't shipped yet. They're waiting on the batch arriving at our Canadian warehouse, which you can follow here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

If you think some PSUs or accessories went through under another email or phone number, send it over and I'll look.
There’s a Gekko Axe GT I’m seeing?
Looked something up in Shopify

Good eye, Travis. The GekkoAxe GT was on your July order, Shop····, when you first placed it. On August 31 it was taken off and swapped for the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703, the one that arrived September 10.

The GekkoAxe isn't owed and isn't coming. The Supra Hex took its place, so nothing on that order is missing.
That I paid for as well….order# ORDER Shop····
Looked something up in Shopify

You're right that you paid for it, Travis. Your one payment on that order was $470.09 on July 25, and it covered the NerdOctaxe and the GekkoAxe GT.

We then upgraded the GekkoAxe to the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 for free. The Supra Hex is the bigger unit, 4.2 TH/s against 2.4, and you weren't charged anything extra for it. We emailed you about the upgrade on September 1.

So the money you paid for the GekkoAxe went to the Supra Hex you received. You haven't been charged for anything you didn't get.
And first one I ever ordered from you was a NerAxe++
Looked something up in Shopify

I can't find a NerdQaxe++ under (email hidden), Travis. The only two orders on that email are the July one and the B30 one.

There's another order under your name that I can't open until you confirm a detail for it. Did you ever check out with a different email address? If you send me that email, I'll pull up everything on it, including the NerdQaxe++ if it's there.
Hmmm could be (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

That email matches, Travis. It has one order, Shop···· from August 1, for the Overclocking add-on ($84.55). It shipped November 8 and is on its way to you. Track it here: (tracking link hidden)

There's still no NerdQaxe++ on either email. It might have gone through on a third email or under a phone number. If you can find a PayPal or card receipt for it, the order number or the email it shows will let me pull it up.
Okay the only reason I ask is because it has stopped working now and I have no way of confirming I ordered it from helium deploy….maybe there a sticker or some type of barcode on it aomewhere?
Looked something up in Shopify

I've checked everything under your name and both emails, Travis, and there's no NerdQaxe++ on any of them. So I can't confirm it came from us yet.

I don't want to guess whether a sticker on the unit could tie it to an order, because I can't match one from here. The quickest proof is the payment itself. Search your PayPal activity or card statement for "HeliumDeploy". If it's there, the order number or email on that receipt will let me pull it up straight away.

Want help getting it running in the meantime?
I already went over many steps with someone last night and it’s being dealt with when the tech team is back on Monday, but thank you.
Used the chat-interview skill

Sounds good, Travis. That ticket is in good hands, and the reply will come to your email.

Before you go, one thing I'm curious about. You ordered the NerdOctaxe and then the B30 pre-order a week later. What made you go bigger so quickly?
Could you tell me the expected date for the BSB30?
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Travis, first I owe you an apology. I told you November 7 back in October, and that date came and went without your B30 shipping. Sorry about that.

The date on your order now is November 15. Your B30 and Power Kit are waiting for the batch to be checked in at our warehouse in Brampton, Ontario. Tracking comes to (email hidden) as soon as the box leaves.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
I always want to go as high TH as possible it’s just an issue of cost most the time - but the BSB was a decent deal so I went for it

That makes sense, Travis. At about $30 per TH, the B30 is one of the best-value units we sell, so you made a good call.

One more question if you don't mind. When you weigh up a miner, what price per TH makes you think "that's a deal, I'll buy it"?
I honestly don’t think to, too much about the cost per TH - but I always do the math to compare and see

That's fair, it's a quick way to compare units side by side. Thanks for telling me, Travis.

Your B30 tracking will come to (email hidden) as soon as it ships. The team will email you about the miner that stopped working once they pick it up on Monday. Have a good weekend.
